draft.shortGloss: to wake up; to snap out of it
notes: This is a reflexive verb, so you need the correct reflexive pronoun (mi, ti, si, ci, vi, si) before it.
Do not confuse it with alzarsi, which means to actually get out of bed after you have woken up.

senses.definition: To stop sleeping and wake up in the morning.

examples.text: Di solito mi sveglio alle sette.
examples.translation: I usually wake up at seven.
examples.emotion: tired and routine, talking about an early morning habit

senses.definition: To become more alert, active, or aware of a situation.

examples.text: È ora di svegliarsi e iniziare a lavorare!
examples.translation: It is time to wake up and start working!
examples.emotion: energetic and motivating, pushing someone to get to work
